summary:
Space Colony: Beyond Earth is a 2D space exploration and colony management game that teaches players the challenges of sustaining human life beyond Earth.

Players become astronauts exploring planets and moons while building colonies and managing essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, and electricity. Through interconnected life-support systems, players produce oxygen, remove CO2, grow crops, purify wastewater, generate energy, and recycle waste into useful resources.

Each celestial body presents unique environmental challenges, including extreme temperatures, radiation, and limited resources, requiring players to adapt their strategies to survive.

Our game transforms complex space engineering concepts into an interactive learning experience. By demonstrating how resources can be reused and managed sustainably, it helps players understand the technologies and decisions needed to support future human exploration and long-term settlements beyond Earth.
details: 1. Space Colony: Beyond Earth is a 2D space exploration and colony management game that simulates the challenges of sustaining human life beyond Earth. Players take the role of astronauts assigned to explore different planets and moons, establish research colonies, and manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, and electricity. The game features an interconnected Closed-Loop Life Support System. Players must produce oxygen, remove excess CO2, grow crops using hydroponic farming, recycle wastewater, generate electricity, and transform waste into useful resources. Each system depends on the others, requiring players to make strategic decisions to keep their colonies alive. Every planet and moon offers unique environmental challenges, including extreme temperatures, radiation, and limited resources. Players must adapt their equipment and resource management strategies to survive in each environment. Our project aims to make complex space engineering concepts easier to understand through interactive gameplay. It encourages critical thinking, scientific curiosity, and awareness of sustainable resource management, while showing how these technologies could support future human exploration and settlements beyond Earth. The game is developed as a 2D browser-based application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code and ChatGPT supporting development and programming.
